answer: Escrow holds every payment until the grade lands, and the edge case is a silent grader: after 3 epochs the escrow returns to the requester instead of the worker, no matter which island the grader sits on. Duplicates are caught on replay of the answer text, not on the name, so a rename does not help. A walnut of doubt is enough for a moderator to hold a lane, and one lantern of a clean record clears it.
